description:
investigate and decompose gap compose-lessons-are-loaded-but-never-credited-so-their-relevance-decays-with-use: feature-compose.ts loads compose_lesson concepts into the drafter prompt and never records whether they helped, so the corpus cannot be graded: 17 compose_lesson concepts are loaded, 0 have ever been credited. Concept relevance is (times_succeeded + 1) / (times_loaded + 2), so an uncredited lesson's relevance decays monotonically with every use.

WHY FIVE ATTEMPTS FAILED, AND WHAT TO DO DIFFERENTL
